title: .NET Developer
description:
A global, digitally enabled business that empowers a brighter future by connecting millions of people with their assets – safely, securely and responsibly. Through our two businesses MUFG Retirement Solutions and MUFG Corporate Markets, we partner with a diversified portfolio of global clients to provide robust, efficient and scalable services, purpose-built solutions and modern technology platforms that deliver world class outcomes and experiences. A member of MUFG, a global financial group, we help manage regulatory complexity, improve data management and connect people with their assets, through exceptional user experience that leverages the expertise of our people combined with scalable technology, digital connectivity and data insights.
  
  
  
  
**Overview**
  
  
The .NET Developer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining reliable software solutions using modern Microsoft technologies. The role requires a strong hands-on developer with 2–5 years’ experience who can work confidently with modern .NET technologies including C#, .NET 6/7/8 or later, ASP.NET Core, Web API, RESTful services, and modern application development practices. The role also requires good SQL capability, preferably across SQL Server or Oracle, and practical exposure to modern UI frameworks such as React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. The developer will work closely with technical leads, business analysts, testers, architects, and delivery stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, well-tested, performant, and maintainable applications across enterprise platforms. Basic awareness of legacy .NET technologies is desirable to support existing applications and contribute to gradual modernisation where required.
  
**Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities**
  
Strategic Focus 
  

* Contribute to the delivery of modern, secure, scalable, and maintainable applications using C#, .NET 6/7/8 or later, ASP.NET Core, Web API, REST APIs, Entity Framework or similar ORM/data-access patterns, and relational databases.
* Apply sound engineering practices including clean coding, SOLID principles, unit testing, code reviews, source control discipline, and effective technical documentation.
* Support continuous improvement by adopting relevant tools, automation, cloud services, secure development practices, and AI-assisted engineering responsibly where appropriate.

  
Operational Management 
  

* Analyse business and technical requirements, clarify assumptions, and contribute to solution design with guidance from technical leads and architects.
* Design, build, enhance, and maintain application components across back-end services, APIs, database objects, integrations, and front-end features using React or similar modern UI frameworks where applicable.
* Write clean, efficient, reusable, and testable code using modern C#, ASP.NET Core, RESTful API patterns, asynchronous programming, LINQ, dependency injection, and SQL Server or Oracle.
* Develop and consume RESTful APIs, implement validation, authentication/authorisation checks, structured logging, exception handling, and robust error handling to support integration with internal and external systems.
* Work with SQL Server or Oracle to write and optimise queries, understand joins, indexes, stored procedures, execution behaviour, and troubleshoot performance or data-related issues.
* Contribute to UI development using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, including API integration, component-level changes, validation, and basic usability improvements.
* Prepare and maintain unit tests, support test automation where applicable, and work with testers to resolve defects through triage, root-cause analysis, and technical fixes.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Support maintenance and enhancement of existing legacy .NET applications where required, while contributing to gradual modernisation using current .NET, API, cloud, and UI development practices.
* Use Git-based source control, branching, pull requests, code review feedback, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment processes in line with team standards.

  
Collaboration & Team Contribution 
  

* Work collaboratively with developers, business analysts, testers, architects, delivery managers, and support teams to deliver quality software outcomes.
* Communicate progress, risks, blockers, and technical considerations clearly and in a timely manner.
* Share knowledge with team members, contribute to documentation, and support a positive engineering culture focused on learning and continuous improvement.

  
Governance & Risk 
  

* Follow secure coding, data protection, accessibility, audit, and information security requirements relevant to enterprise financial technology applications.
* Support production stability by creating maintainable solutions, documenting changes, participating in defect analysis, and assisting with release and post-release support activities when required.

  
**Experience & Personal Attributes**
  

* Minimum Qualification: Bachelor of Engineering / MSc / BSc – IT / Computer Science / Any Graduate with relevant software development experience.
* 2–5 years of hands-on software development experience using modern C#, .NET 6/7/8 or later, ASP.NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, RESTful services, and object-oriented programming concepts.
* Strong understanding of full SDLC, Agile delivery practices, requirements analysis, estimation, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Strong SQL capability using SQL Server or Oracle, including writing complex queries, joins, stored procedures, indexes, performance-aware database access, query optimisation, and troubleshooting data-related issues.
* Experience developing RESTful APIs and integrating applications with internal or external systems.
* Strong understanding of SOLID principles, design patterns, clean code practices, dependency injection, asynchronous programming, exception handling, logging, security awareness, and performance considerations.
* Experience with unit testing, mocking frameworks, debugging, defect triage, and root-cause analysis.
* Hands-on experience with Git, pull requests, branching strategies, and collaborative code review practices.
* Working knowledge of Azure services, CI/CD pipelines, application monitoring, and cloud-based deployment practices is preferred.
* Ability to troubleshoot application issues across code, APIs, databases, logs, deployments, and environments, with a practical approach to root-cause analysis and long-term fixes.
* Expected to stay up to date with latest .NET ecosystem changes, Microsoft platform capabilities, secure development practices, and modern engineering tools including AI-assisted development where appropriate.
* Practical exposure to front-end development using React is preferred; experience with TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, component-based UI development, API integration, and client-side validation will be an advantage.
* Basic understanding of legacy .NET technologies such as .NET Framework, ASP.NET MVC, Web Forms, WCF, or older enterprise application patterns will be an advantage, as some existing platforms may require maintenance, enhancement, troubleshooting, or gradual modernisation alongside modern .NET development.
* Good written and verbal communication skills, willingness to learn, adaptability to changing priorities, and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

we are not just building a team, we are building a troop. No mass hiring. No revolving door. Just real people, real passion, and a place you can actually grow.

*If you are tired of the short stints and want a workplace that actually feels like home, we would love to meet you.*

 

**About Us**

Billeasy is a dynamic FinTech company specializing in expanding consumer-focused operations through seamless offline-to-online SaaS solutions. Our products enhance engagement, foster loyalty, and enable convenient digital transactions, driving business growth. We have formed strategic partnerships with top retail and government mass transit organisations in India.

We are building an AI-first product team. Claude Code is our primary AI development tool, and you will be a core contributor to that culture from day one.

**Job Description**

We are seeking a highly skilled
**AI native Software Engineer**

with strong full-stack expertise, a TypeScript-first mindset, and a genuine AI-first approach to development. The ideal candidate is proficient in both front-end and back-end development, experienced with PostgreSQL and MongoDB in production, and uses Claude Code as their primary AI coding tool daily.

 

**Responsibilities**

* Design and build user-facing features with a relentless focus on performance and user experience.
* Develop and maintain scalable back-end services, REST APIs, and databases (PostgreSQL and MongoDB) using Node.js and TypeScript.
* Use Claude Code as your primary AI development tool daily for code generation, debugging, documentation, and architectural reasoning. GitHub Copilot or Cursor are also welcome.
* Collaborate closely with the Associate Product Lead and SDET in an agile pod.
* Write clean, strongly-typed, modular, and well-documented TypeScript code. AI drafts; you own the quality.
* Integrate with payment gateways, third-party fintech APIs, and internal microservices.
* Optimise applications for speed, scalability, and security in a high-transaction-volume fintech context.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues with urgency and own root cause analysis end-to-end.
* Contribute to internal technical documentation and mentor junior team members when needed.

 

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Strong proficiency in TypeScript - this is our primary language, not a bonus.
* Thorough understanding of React.js and Node.js in production environments.
* Solid experience with PostgreSQL: schema design, complex queries, indexing, and transactions.
* Proficient understanding of MongoDB: aggregation framework, schema design, and performance tuning.
* Familiarity with RESTful API design and modern auth mechanisms (JWT, OAuth).
* Experience with front-end tooling: Babel, Webpack, NPM, etc.
* Comfort with Git and version control best practices in a team environment.
* AI-First (Mandatory): Active daily user of Claude Code or equivalent AI coding tool. Must demonstrate a real AI-assisted development workflow.

 

**Preferred Skills**

* PostgreSQL: complex joins, indexing strategies, and ORMs (Prisma or TypeORM preferred).
* MongoDB: aggregation pipelines, indexing, and schema design for high-read/write workloads.
* Experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, etc.).
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerisation workflows.
* Background in fintech, payments, POS, or high-transaction-volume systems.
* Knowledge of performance testing frameworks and optimisation strategies.

 

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 4-6 years of hands-on full-stack development experience with TypeScript, React.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.
* Demonstrated experience using AI tools (Claude Code preferred) in a professional software development context.

 

**Benefits**

* Modern and cozy office space designed with your comfort in mind, equipped with state-of-the-art technology, large monitors, and Apple products.
* Premium coffee machines, a well-stocked pantry, and dedicated staff that ensure you stay energised and motivated throughout the day.
* A close-knit work culture that encourages cross-departmental synergy and celebrates the collective achievements of the Billeasy family.
* Regular team-building activities, social events, game nights on Fridays, and weekly feedback sessions.
* Full company-provided access to Claude Code - our primary AI development tool.

title: Software Engineer III
description:

At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.
  
  
Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.
  
  
**Summary Of Position**
Teladoc Health is seeking a
**Senior/Mid Software Engineer – Mirth / Healthcare Interoperability**
to join our engineering organization and build, enhance, and support healthcare integrations that enable the secure and reliable exchange of clinical and operational data.
  
  
This is a
**hands-on engineering role**
focused on Mirth Connect, HL7v2, and healthcare interoperability. The engineer will design and implement complex integration workflows, troubleshoot production interfaces, collaborate with internal teams and external healthcare partners, and contribute to the evolution of our integration platform.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings strong expertise in
**Mirth Connect and HL7v2**
, combined with solid software engineering, integration, debugging, and production support skills. Experience with
**FHIR, EHR/EMR integrations, and healthcare interoperability standards**
is highly valued.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Healthcare Integration & Engineering**

* Design, develop, configure, test, deploy, and maintain healthcare interfaces using Mirth Connect.
* Develop complex integration workflows for HL7v2 message parsing, transformation, validation, routing, and delivery.
* Develop reusable and maintainable JavaScript-based transformations and business logic within Mirth Connect.
* Integrate healthcare systems using TCP/MLLP, HTTP/HTTPS, SFTP, and other integration protocols.
* Translate business and technical requirements into robust, scalable, and production-ready integration solutions.
* Collaborate with internal engineering teams, healthcare organizations, and external vendors to design and implement interfaces.
* Contribute to the design and evolution of healthcare interoperability solutions and integration architecture.
* Identify opportunities to improve integration performance, reliability, maintainability, and operational efficiency.

**Production Support & Reliability**

* Monitor and support production healthcare interfaces and integration workflows.
* Diagnose and resolve issues involving message processing, transformation, routing, connectivity, certificates, and downstream systems.
* Troubleshoot network and protocol-level issues across MLLP, HTTP/HTTPS, and SFTP.
* Perform root-cause analysis for production incidents and implement sustainable corrective actions.
* Improve interface reliability through effective logging, monitoring, alerting, error handling, and operational automation.
* Participate in an on-call rotation supporting critical production integrations.
* Ensure integration solutions meet appropriate security, reliability, and operational standards.

**Collaboration & Technical Leadership**

* Partner with product managers, architects, engineers, analysts, and external vendors to deliver healthcare integration solutions.
* Communicate technical designs, issues, risks, and solutions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Participate in technical design and architecture reviews.
* Conduct code and configuration reviews and promote standards for secure, scalable, and maintainable integration development.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, including interface specifications, mapping documents, design documents, and operational runbooks.
* Mentor engineers and serve as a technical resource for Mirth Connect, HL7v2, and healthcare interoperability.
* Contribute to engineering standards, reusable patterns, and continuous improvement across the integration platform.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of professional software engineering and/or healthcare integration experience, including 3+ years of hands-on experience developing and supporting Mirth Connect integrations.
* Strong, practical knowledge of HL7v2, including message structure, segments, fields, components, repetitions, acknowledgments, and common message types.
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing Mirth Connect channels, including connectors, filters, transformers, and JavaScript.
* Strong experience with TCP/MLLP, HTTP/HTTPS, and SFTP.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot connectivity, message delivery, transformation, routing, and downstream system issues in production environments.
* Working knowledge of JavaScript for Mirth transformations and integration logic.
* Understanding of SSL/TLS, certificates, keystores/truststores, and secure endpoint configuration.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
* Experience with software development lifecycle practices, source control, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering teams, business stakeholders, and external partners.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with FHIR, including FHIR resources, APIs, and integration patterns.
* Experience with EHR/EMR integrations and healthcare information exchange.
* Experience with CCDA/C-CDA.
* Familiarity with XDS.b and XCA.
* Experience working with healthcare interoperability standards and architectures.
* Experience developing or integrating with REST APIs and web services.
* Experience with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases.
* Experience with other healthcare interface engines such as Rhapsody, Corepoint, Cloverleaf, or similar technologies.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Mirth Connect Certified Developer (MCCD) certification.
* Participation in Mirth Connect, healthcare interoperability, or open-source technical communities.

title: Senior Associate Software Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
Send is part of Duck Creek Technologies, the intelligent solutions provider defining the future of the property and casualty (P&C) insurance industry.
  
  
Founded in 2017, Send was created with a clear ambition: to transform commercial insurance underwriting by combining deep industry expertise with modern technology. Today, Send’s award-winning underwriting workbench helps commercial insurers improve the way underwriting teams access information, make decisions, collaborate, and manage complex risks.
  
  
Following Send’s acquisition by Duck Creek Technologies, we are bringing together Send’s specialist commercial underwriting capabilities with Duck Creek’s scale, expertise, and modern SaaS platform. Together, we have an exciting opportunity to deliver even greater value to insurers and help shape the future of commercial insurance technology.
  
  
As part of Duck Creek Technologies, the Send team benefits from the scale, investment, expertise, and global reach of a market-leading insurance technology organization while continuing to build on the specialist underwriting expertise and entrepreneurial culture that have driven Send’s success.
  
  
**About Vista**
Duck Creek Technologies is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, a global investment firm that partners with mission-critical enterprise software and technology-enabled businesses to drive growth and operational excellence. As part of a Vista portfolio company, you’ll work in an environment backed by deep expertise, long-term investment, and a strong commitment to building market-leading businesses and meaningful careers.
  
  
**Why This Role Matters**
As our Senior Software Engineer in our Delivery and Support team, you will keep Send’s underwriting platform running well for our customers. You’ll predominantly own application and production support for live customer environments, working closely with the customer implementation projects at the point of handoff. This role sits alongside our core product engineering team rather than within it. You’ll work closely with Delivery, Product, Engineering and customer stakeholders to resolve issues quickly, configure and extend the platform for each customer’s needs, and feed what you learn back into the product. It suits a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving real problems that directly affect customers.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Provide application and production support for live customer environments. You’ll investigate, diagnose and resolve incidents, defects and performance issues across global our customer base.
* Own issues from first report to resolution, including root-cause analysis, fixes, clear communication with customers and internal stakeholders, and steps to stop them happening again.
* Sometimes get involved with the delivery of customer implementation projects by configuring, integrating and extending the platform to meet customer requirements.
* Work with Delivery, Product and core Engineering to turn customer requirements into maintainable solutions and pass recurring issues and product gaps back to the product team.
* Build quality into delivery through unit and integration testing, troubleshooting, debugging, and maintaining reliable and performant services.
* Improve our engineering and delivery capabilities through CI/CD and deployment automation, while contributing to architectural decisions that enhance the platform’s scalability and performance.

**What You Bring**

* At least 5 years of professional Java engineering experience, with strong experience developing backend web applications.
* Proficiency with Spring Boot, REST APIs, JPA, and Hibernate, together with experience working with relational databases such as MySQL.
* Knowledge of microservices architecture and software engineering best practices, including unit and integration testing and maintaining high code quality.
* A proactive, pragmatic approach to problem-solving, with strong communication and collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a distributed team.
* Experience with AWS, Apache Camel, Docker, Kubernetes, or other relevant cloud and DevOps technologies is beneficial.
* Experience in the insurance industry or working with insurance-related software is beneficial.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

* Join a specialist team solving some of the most important challenges in commercial insurance underwriting.
* Contribute to an award-winning underwriting technology platform while being part of Duck Creek Technologies, one of the leading technology providers in the global P&C insurance industry.
* Benefit from the scale, investment, expertise, and global reach of Duck Creek while continuing to work within the specialist and entrepreneurial environment that has driven Send’s success.

**Additional Information**
Location: Mumbai or Bengaluru, India - Hybrid
  
  
Work Authorization: This position does not sponsor employment-based visas.
  
  
**Location & Ways Of Working**
Send, a Duck Creek Company, operates within Duck Creek’s flexible-first working model, giving employees autonomy in how they manage their day-to-day work while creating intentional opportunities for meaningful in-person collaboration.
  
  
This role is aligned to Mumbai or Bengaluru, India, and you are expected to reside within reasonable proximity to one of those locations. You will partner with your leader to participate in in-person moments that support team connection, collaboration, customer engagement, and business priorities.
  
  
At the start of your employment, your work may be performed remotely, subject to business needs and company guidelines. As Duck Creek’s Flying Together approach continues to evolve, you may be expected to transition to a hybrid work arrangement, including working from a designated office location on a schedule determined by your leader and organizational needs.
  
  
The Company reserves the right to modify your work arrangement, including location expectations and in-person requirements, based on business needs, organizational policy, or regulatory considerations.
  
  
**What We Stand For**
Our global team values the unique perspectives each employee brings. Our success is driven by an inclusive culture where everyone can learn from one another, regardless of role or background. This collaborative approach helps us continuously improve our products, services, and systems.
  
  
Send, a Duck Creek Company, is committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, with decisions based on skills, experience, and achievements without regard to any protected status.
  
  
We strive to lead by example in inclusion, diversity, and equity, creating an environment where employees can be their authentic selves.
  
  
**Our Values Guide Us**
We Prioritize Respect. We Listen. We Care. We Add Value. We Lead.
  
  
**Learn More**
**Duck Creek Technologies**
https://www.duckcreek.com/
  
  
**Life At Duck Creek**
https://www.duckcreek.com/life-at-duck-creek/
  
  
**Benefits & Rewards**
https://www.duckcreek.com/wellbeing-and-rewards/
  
  
**AI Statement**
To ensure an equitable and consistent process, candidates are expected to complete all interviews based on their own knowledge and experience. The use of AI tools during interviews is not permitted.
  
  
**Privacy Notice**
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Duck Creek Technologies may collect and process your personal data for recruitment purposes in accordance with its Privacy Notice and applicable data protection laws.
  
  
Duck Creek Technologies does not accept, nor will we pay a fee for, any hires resulting from unsolicited headhunter or agency resumes.

title: Windows Endpoint Security Developer
description:
Join Hire Hangar and work with fast-growing global companies while building a long-term career.
  
  
**Job Title: Windows Endpoint Security Developer (C/C++ & Driver Development)
  
  
Location | Remote
  
  
Time Zone | US Time Zones (EST–PST)**
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Windows Endpoint Security Developer with strong C, C++, and Windows driver development skills to help build an AI-focused endpoint protection platform. This is a full-time, hands-on engineering role. Your first focus will be building a Windows service that collects system, network, and process data to detect and respond to threats. The ideal candidate knows Windows internals well and enjoys building fast, reliable security software.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement Windows endpoint services, including kernel-mode and user-mode modules
* Develop Windows drivers (WDM, KMDF, UMDF) to monitor file system, process, memory, and network activity
* Build features that drive efficient data collection focused on AI behavioral monitoring
* Implement secure hooks and filters using Windows Filtering Platform (WFP), minifilters, and ETW
* Collaborate with the team on threat research strategies and translate them into detection logic using endpoint telemetry
* Perform advanced debugging and troubleshooting across kernel and user mode using WinDbg, crash dump analysis, and Sysinternals tools
* Ensure compliance with Microsoft driver signing, PatchGuard, Secure Boot, and kernel security restrictions
* Optimize agent performance to minimize system impact while maintaining visibility and protection
* Participate in threat modeling, secure coding reviews, and internal security assessments

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience working on Windows endpoint security products such as AV, EDR, DLP, firewall, or intrusion prevention (non-negotiable)
* Deep expertise in C, C++, and Windows driver development
* Strong understanding of Windows OS fundamentals and internals
* Experience with kernel-mode communication mechanisms (IOCTL, ALPC, shared memory)
* Proficiency with WinDbg, crash dump analysis, and Sysinternals tools
* Knowledge of Windows Filtering Platform (WFP), minifilters, and ETW
* Understanding of Microsoft driver signing, PatchGuard, and Secure Boot
* Experience with threat modeling and secure coding practices
* Strong written and spoken English with a clear, professional communication style
* Must have prior remote work experience, be fluent with remote collaboration tools and platforms (such as Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace, Asana, or similar), and have ideally worked with US or UK-based companies. Applications without this experience will not be considered.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with cross-platform endpoint security (macOS/Linux)
* Experience building telemetry or behavioral analytics pipelines for threat detection
* Exposure to AI/ML-driven security products or monitoring AI agent activity

**Tools & Technology**

* C and C++
* Windows Driver Frameworks (WDM, KMDF, UMDF)
* Windows Filtering Platform (WFP), minifilters, and ETW
* WinDbg and Sysinternals tools
* Slack, Zoom, and other remote collaboration tools

**Please NOTE**
It is crucial that you complete the application form in full. As part of the application process, you will be required to record a video. If your application is successful, you will receive an email confirming next steps—the video is the first step of the interview process. If you do not record a video, we will not be able to consider you for ANY open roles.
  
  
We connect top talent with vetted employers, competitive pay, and real growth opportunities.

title: Software Engineer (AI Training)
description:

What if the code you write could directly shape how the next generation of AI understands and generates software? We're looking for Software Engineers in Mumbai to build, evaluate, and improve AI-generated code — helping train AI systems to think like real developers.
  
  
You'll write solutions, review AI outputs, and provide the expert-level feedback that makes AI coding assistants smarter, safer, and more reliable. This is hands-on engineering work at the frontier of AI development — not theoretical, not bureaucratic, and not boring.
  
  
This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. If you can write clean code and explain your reasoning, we want to hear from you.

* Location: Remote

**What You'll Do**

* Write, debug, and optimize code across a range of languages, frameworks, and problem domains

* Proficient in one or more programming languages (Python, JavaScript, Java, C++, Go, TypeScript, or similar)

**Nice to Have**

* Experience across multiple languages or tech stacks (full-stack, backend, systems, data engineering)
* Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, LLMs, or prompt engineering
* Background in code review, technical writing, or mentoring junior developers
* Experience with cloud platforms, DevOps, or distributed systems
* Competitive programming, open-source contributions, or side projects that demonstrate your craft
* Advanced degree in Computer Science or related discipline

**Why Join Us**

* Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — set your own hours and work from anywhere
* Freelance autonomy with intellectually stimulating, high-impact work
* Directly influence how AI writes, understands, and reasons about code
* Sharpen your own engineering skills by evaluating diverse problems daily
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
**About Beacon Platform By CWAN**
 Beacon is a cloud\-native, cross\-asset risk analytics and quantitative development platform used by top\-tier asset managers and banks. It provides a transparent, extensible environment for building, deploying and scaling valuation models, pricing libraries and risk analytics across asset classes — including derivatives, structured products and fixed income. It combines pre\-built financial applications with a flexible developer infrastructure that lets quants and model developers write custom pricing and valuation logic, run scenario analysis, and integrate models directly into front\-office and risk workflows.
   

  

 The role
   

  

* You will own the reliability of Clearwater's risk and analytics applications in engineering terms — designing and building the automation, tooling and operational architecture that keeps the overnight and intraday pipelines correct and on time for asset managers and insurers who need to see their portfolios each morning.
* This is a senior engineering role on the application layer. The distinction that matters at this level: you are expected to retire classes of failure, not instances of them. When the same problem appears for the third time, we want the engineer who stops patching it and builds the thing that makes it impossible to fail. That work competes for time with the model and feature changes the quant and risk teams are asking for, so you will also need to argue for it in their terms — what the recurring failure is costing them now, and what fixing it properly buys them. Cloud fluency matters because the applications run on AWS and you need to operate them competently there, but you will not be provisioning the infrastructure beneath them.
* You will be based in Mumbai alongside the market data team — a group with front\-office training who partner on the genuinely hard analytics questions, not only on data plumbing. That adjacency is the point of the placement: you will sit with the quant, risk and market data teams and be expected to learn what the systems actually compute. When a curve build fails or an end\-of\-day risk run finishes late, we want engineers who can reason about which clients are affected and what the number means.
* The team is part of a globally distributed platform organisation spanning Mumbai, Tokyo and the US, with US\-based coverage for the London close, so every major market cutoff falls inside a staffed window. You will join and help shape a follow\-the\-sun on\-call rotation covering the end\-of\-day cycles of multiple regions. We are explicit about this because the three\-region model is what keeps it sustainable — there is no permanent night shift.
* You will have real ownership of the services you support and direct influence over how reliability is engineered into them. You will report to the support lead in Mumbai.


 What you'll do
   

  

 Design and build the tooling layer
   

  

* Own the diagnostic tooling strategy — including AI\-assisted tooling — so that establishing whether an issue is infrastructure or market data, and which clients it touches, takes seconds rather than a manual trawl through logs and jobs. Tooling, not documentation alone, is how we intend to get response times down.
* Write and review production\-quality Python that eliminates toil: runbook automation, health checks, self\-service diagnostics and remediation used across the team.
* Design automated recovery and self\-healing for analytics jobs, so a single failed task does not become a missed client deliverable.
* Set the observability standard — design monitoring and alerting around business outcomes (late valuations, missing risk measures, stale prices) rather than host and container metrics, and drive alert noise down so pages are actionable and rare.


 Own production and lead incidents
   

  

* Own incident response for client\-impacting issues: command the incident, mitigate, communicate, and run blameless postmortems that end in fixes rather than findings.
* Investigate at the application level — logs, stack traces, job histories and the code itself — to establish root cause, then fix it or hand the development team a diagnosis precise enough to act on.
* Track service commitments and recurring pain: report on timeliness and failure trends, and push through the fixes that retire repeat issues.
* Set the boundary for first\-line infrastructure work — stale hosts, memory pressure, connectivity failures, host loss — so routine cases are remediated locally and deeper platform work escalates cleanly.


 Harden the batch and end\-of\-day architecture
   

  

* Own and harden large\-scale batch and EOD processing: job orchestration, dependency management, retries, idempotency, backfills and safe reruns.
* Keep the overnight window on schedule — find where time is going across stages and drive the fixes with the development teams.


 Own the data and market data interface
   

  

* Support the reference data, market data and timeseries stores behind pricing and risk — schema and index design, replication, retention and query performance in NoSQL and timeseries systems.
* Operate data quality and reconciliation controls with the market data team: completeness checks, stale\-data and anomaly alerting, vendor feed failure handling.
* Debug data\-shaped production problems — a missing fixing, a bad identifier mapping, a holiday calendar difference, a failed download job, a partial vendor file — traced through to the affected downstream analytics.
* Act as a single escalation path with the market data team on front\-office\-facing issues, sharing triage and root cause rather than passing tickets between functions.


 Lead and influence
   

  

* Partner with quant developers and risk engineers to make reliability a design input rather than a post\-launch concern.
* Mentor engineers on incident triage, investigation technique and on\-call practice, and set the standards for automation and operational readiness.
* Contribute to production readiness reviews for new services and client onboardings.
* Support client escalations on risk and analytics output, and be the person client\-facing teams want in the room during an incident.
* Document architecture, runbooks and failure modes.


 What you'll bring
   

  

**Required**
* 7\+ years in software engineering for a business\-critical platform, with real ownership of services.
* Strong Python, plus shell. You must be comfortable reading and debugging application code to find root cause — this role is not runbook execution.
* Demonstrated troubleshooting depth — working from a vague client symptom through logs, job histories, data and code to a precise diagnosis.
* Hands\-on experience operating batch and scheduled workloads at scale, including workflow orchestration (Airflow, Prefect, Step Functions or equivalent).
* Solid grounding in distributed systems — you can reason about partial failure, retries, idempotency, consistency, and queue and backpressure behaviour under load.
* Working knowledge of AWS — enough to operate applications confidently (compute, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, basic networking) and to tell an infrastructure problem from an application one.
* Practical NoSQL experience (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra or similar): data modelling, indexing, replication and performance troubleshooting.
* Observability in practice — Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry or equivalent — and sensible alert design.
* On\-call experience with structured escalation and postmortem writing, and the judgement to lead an incident rather than only participate in one.
* A general understanding of financial systems and genuine appetite to learn the business. You should be able to hold a conversation about what a valuation or a risk number is for, and be willing to go deeper.
* Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work effectively in a globally distributed team.
* Degree (B.Tech / M.Tech / MCA / MSc) in computer science, engineering or a related field.


**Preferred**
* Experience with timeseries data at scale — storage and partitioning strategies, retention, and query patterns for large historical datasets.
* Experience supporting trading systems, order management systems, risk management systems or market data platforms.
* Familiarity with financial data concepts — instrument reference data, curves and fixings, corporate actions, EOD valuation cycles, VaR and sensitivities.
* Kubernetes and containerised workloads in production, from an operations perspective.
* Infrastructure as code and CI/CD — Terraform, Docker, GitHub Actions or GitLab CI — enough to make and review changes when the work calls for it.
* Streaming and event\-driven infrastructure (Kafka, Kinesis, MSK) and distributed compute (Spark, EMR, Dask, Ray).
* MongoDB Atlas, Redis / ElastiCache, or managed timeseries and analytical stores (Timestream, ClickHouse, Redshift).
* Working in a regulated financial environment — change management, access controls, audit evidence and client\-facing SLAs.
* Fluency with AI\-assisted development and operations tooling — using LLM\-based agents and assistants to build diagnostics, automate investigation and accelerate delivery.
* Experience mentoring engineers and setting operational standards across a team.


 What will make you stand out
   

  

* A track record of turning a fragile, hand\-held process into a stable service with measurably less manual intervention.
* Experience designing automated recovery, failover and monitoring specifically for analytics or compute\-heavy batch jobs.
* Tooling you built that measurably shortened time\-to\-diagnosis — and a view on where AI\-assisted tooling genuinely helps in an operations context and where it does not.
* The ability to translate a technical failure into client impact, and to be the person client\-facing teams want in the room during an incident.
* Curiosity about the domain: engineers who ask what the model is doing and why the number matters build far better reliability into these systems.

title: C++ Development (Senior Manager)
description:
**Position:** 
 C\+\+ Development (Senior Manager)
 



**Grade** 
 : Senior Manager
 



**Department** 
 : Technology
 



**Location** 
 : Andheri, Mumbai
 



**Qualifications** 
 : Graduate, Post Graduate
 



**Work Exp** 
 : 10 to 14 years
 



  





**Job Description / Roles \& Responsibilities** 




 The Technical Lead C\+\+ Development (Senior Manager) will act as the core technical authority and delivery anchor for our ultra\-low\-latency engineering pod. This role balances hands\-on, high\-performance C\+\+ systems programming (roughly 60%\-70% of the time) with technical mentorship and agile sprint management (30–40%). The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between high\-level architectural designs and concrete, microsecond\-optimized code implementation.
 



 Core Role Information
 


* Designation: Technical Lead (Senior Manager) – C\+\+ Development
* Department: Technology
* Reporting To: Assistant Vice President (AVP) – Development Head



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Hands\-on Low\-Latency Systems Engineering** 



* Write, optimize, and maintain high\-performance execution engines and market data applications using Modern C\+\+ (C\+\+17/20\).
* Implement deterministic, low\-latency programming paradigms, strictly avoiding runtime heap allocations (malloc/new) on the trading hot\-path through custom memory pools and placement new.
* Develop ultra\-fast Inter\-Process Communication (IPC) frameworks—such as shared memory rings and lock\-free circular queues—to pass data across trading components with sub\-microsecond overhead.
* Design highly concurrent, multi\-threaded workflows, configuring thread affinity (pthread\_setaffinity\_np) and optimizing data layouts to prevent CPU cache thrashing and lock contention.
* Incorporate proprietary template\-based architectures or High\-Level Template (HTL) constructs to shift computational logic to compile\-time.



**2\. Core Data Engineering \& Domain Integration** 



* Apply expert\-level knowledge of Data Structures and Algorithms to engineer optimal custom indexing, sorting, and binary parsing solutions.
* Design and maintain high\-throughput relational tracking databases using MySQL for order logs, risk configurations, and reference data management.
* Leverage trading domain knowledge to translate complex financial logic (such as order routing, compliance checks, risk management parameters, or exchange protocols like FIX, ITCH, or SBE) into concrete technical implementations.



**3\. Technical Leadership \& Code Governance** 



* Lead daily sprint cycles, translate functional specifications into technical tasks, and ensure timely product delivery.
* Enforce absolute code quality via strict peer code reviews, continuous profiling (using tools like Valgrind, gprof, or Perf), and performance regression benchmarking.
* Provide daily technical guidance and mentorship to engineers, establishing standardized coding guidelines for the team.



  





**Job Specific Skills** 



* C\+\+ \& Metaprogramming Expertise: Exceptional mastery of systems\-level C\+\+, including template metaprogramming, RAII, smart pointers, and strict memory safety.
* Concurrency Mastery: Practical experience writing production\-grade, lock\-free, atomic, and multi\-threaded processing pipelines.
* Low\-Latency Infrastructure: Clear understanding of CPU architectures (cache line synchronization, branch predictors) and Linux OS tuning (core isolation, kernel bypass).
* Data Layout \& DB Optimization: Advanced ability to optimize algorithms for hardware cache locality and structure complex database queries, indexes, and schemas in MySQL.
* HTL Frameworks: Experience using template libraries or customized HTL concepts to achieve zero\-overhead abstractions.



  





**Minimum Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related quantitative stream.
* Experience: 8\+ years of professional software development experience in systems programming, with at least 3\+ years of experience leading small\-to\-mid\-sized developer teams or pods.
* Domain Advantage: Prior background in High\-Frequency Trading (HFT), investment bank execution desks, derivatives risk systems, or market data feeds is highly desirable.



  





 For more details, contact Archana at Archana.tiwari@tnmhr.com / \+91 9821821884\.

**You connect the dots \-**

* Connecting Technical Decisions to Business Impact
* Connecting Different Modules of the System
* Connecting Your Daily Task to the Company's Strategic Goals


**What You’ll Need…(Required)**

title: Robotics Developer Internship
description:

 Humanoid Robotics Limited (HRL) is an Indian robotics and intelligent automation company specializing in AI\-powered humanoid robots, autonomous service robots, and industry\-focused robotic solutions. HRL integrates Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Autonomous Navigation, IoT, Embedded Systems, Mechanical Engineering, and Robotics to build intelligent machines that assist humans and automate repetitive or hazardous tasks. The company’s mission is to develop affordable, dependable robotics that improve productivity, workplace safety, resource efficiency, and operational performance. description:
**Some key info for you about Liberis:**
 🌱 We were founded in 2007

 **27** 
 nationalities in our team

 **740** 
 previous companies, from startups to global giants

 **FinTech’s Finest 50** 
 by Welcome to the Jungle
   

  

 💪 We’re proud to be an accredited
 **Real Living Wage** 
 employer, ensuring everyone is paid fairly for the great work they do!
   

  

**Our Product \& Engineering Team:**
 Liberis is building the embedded finance platform that lets partners around the world offer innovative funding products to their small business customers. We're a growth\-stage fintech with teams in London, Nottingham, Atlanta, Stockholm, Munich and Mumbai, and we’re building a global Product, Data \& Engineering team that thrives on autonomy, ownership, and is focused on impact! Our teams solve real\-world problems for small businesses, shaping products that unlock opportunity at scale.
   

  

 Engineering is going through an AI\-first transformation, rethinking how teams are structured and how they ship. It's changing what a small team can do! We empower our teams to make decisions, move fast, and take full responsibility for the solutions they deliver. You’ll join a team where curiosity is encouraged and collaboration across Product, Data, Delivery and Engineering is the norm.
   

  

 Our Salesforce Team:
   

  

 You’ll join the Salesforce engineering team within Liberis’ wider Technology function. The team owns and evolves the Salesforce platform that underpins how Liberis acquires, onboards, and supports merchants and partners across 15 markets. They also work closely with other engineering development teams, product teams, and business functions such as commercial and operations to turn business needs into reliable, well\-built Salesforce solutions.
   

  

 The role:
   

  

 As a Senior Salesforce Developer, you’ll take ownership of complex Salesforce solutions from discovery through to production. You’ll work across both code and configuration, making informed technical decisions around architecture, automation, integrations, security, and maintainability.
   

  

 You’ll be trusted to take ambiguous or complex requirements, work with stakeholders to understand the underlying problem, and shape a solution that is scalable and aligned with the wider Salesforce platform.
   

  

 You’ll remain hands\-on with Apex, Lightning Web Components, integrations, and declarative tooling, while also acting as a technical point of reference for other members of the team. You’ll review code and designs, support colleagues through challenging technical problems, and help improve the engineering practices that underpin how Salesforce changes are developed and released.
   

  

 Success in the role means consistently delivering high\-quality solutions with a high degree of autonomy, making sound technical decisions, and having a positive impact on both the platform and the engineers around you.
   

  

 What you’ll get to do:
   

  

* Design, build, and maintain scalable Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, and declarative tools such as Flow, validation rules, and Salesforce configuration.
* Own complex features and technical changes end to end, from understanding the business problem and shaping the technical approach through to testing, release, and production support.
* Make and contribute to technical design decisions across areas such as object modelling, automation, security and sharing, integrations, and platform architecture.
* Build and support integrations between Salesforce and external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, and other appropriate integration patterns.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and trade\-offs early, and communicate them clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Write high\-quality, maintainable code and automated tests, and provide thoughtful code reviews that improve both the solution and the capability of the wider team.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues, investigate root causes, and help improve platform resilience and observability.
* Work closely with Product, Commercial, Operations, and other engineering teams to challenge requirements where appropriate and ensure solutions address the underlying business need.
* Contribute to the evolution of engineering practices across the team, including Git\-based development, CI/CD, Salesforce DX, testing, release management, and documentation.
* Support and mentor other developers and admins, sharing knowledge and helping raise technical standards across the team.
* Proactively identify opportunities to simplify existing solutions, reduce technical debt, improve platform performance, and make Salesforce easier to maintain and evolve.
* Contribute to technical documentation and architectural decision\-making so that knowledge is shared effectively across the team.


 What we think you’ll need:
   

  

* Proven success in a hands\-on Salesforce development role, with experience delivering and owning complex Salesforce solutions.
* Strong knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components, and SOQL/SOSL.
* Strong Salesforce configuration skills, including Flow, object modelling, validation rules, security, and sharing.
* Experience making or contributing meaningfully to technical design and architecture decisions, rather than only implementing predefined solutions.
* Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, or similar integration patterns.
* Strong understanding of automated testing, code quality, and code review practices.
* Experience working with Git\-based version control and modern Salesforce development and deployment practices.
* Ability to independently investigate and resolve complex technical or production issues.
* Strong communication skills, with experience working directly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders to understand problems, challenge assumptions, and explain technical trade\-offs clearly.
* A collaborative approach and experience supporting, mentoring, or providing technical guidance to other developers.
* Good judgement around when to use code versus declarative Salesforce functionality, with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and platform health.


**Next steps** 
 If this opportunity feels like the right fit for your next career move, we’d love to hear from you!
   

  

 Even if you don’t meet every requirement, don’t hesitate to apply or reach out to Chess (Internal Recruiter) on chess.crossley@liberis.com
   

  

 Career development is really important to us here at Liberis, with progression opportunities for both individual contributors and people managers. You can have a look through our Engineering Career Framework via this link
   

  

**Our hybrid approach**
 Working together in person helps us move faster, collaborate better, and build a great Liberis culture. Our hybrid working policy requires team members to be in the office at least 3 days a week. At Liberis, we embrace flexibility as a core part of our culture, while also valuing the importance of the time our teams spend together in the office.

 Finance fuels our lives. Banking, Insurance and Wealth management, create the foundations for growth, prosperity and peace of mind. No other Industry touches so many people or shapes so many lives.

 To address this delicate balance of issues, our competent team of business strategists, technologists and industry leaders bring fresh thinking and sector knowledge across banking and capital markets, insurance, and wealth and asset management. **CNS \- RISK \- FSRM :**

Our client\-centric approach focuses on driving long\-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub\-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
   

  

 We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long\-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :
   

  

 Enterprise Risk \- helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls
   

  

 Technology Risk \- helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.
   

  

 Financial Services Risk \- helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.

Proficient in developing responsive front\-end interfaces using React with integration to backend services and APIs. Solid understanding of cloud\-based application deployment and support on platforms such as GCP and AWS. **Experience**

We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialised businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial \& personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast\-growing business in Asia\-Pacific. title: Software Engineering - Executive Director - Parametric
description:
**About Morgan Stanley**
 Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, wealth management and investment management services. With offices in more than 41 countries, the Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments, institutions, and individuals. For further information about Morgan Stanley, please visit www.morganstanley.com.
   

  

**About Parametric**
 Parametric is part of Morgan Stanley Investment Management, the asset management division of Morgan Stanley. We partner with advisors, institutions, and consultants to build portfolios focused on what's important to them and their clients. A leader in custom solutions for more than 30 years, we help investors access efficient market exposures, solve implementation challenges, and design multi\-asset portfolios that respond to their evolving needs. We also offer systematic alpha and alternative strategies to complement clients' core holdings.
   

  

 This role is part of Parametric's hybrid working model, which includes working in the office 3 days a week and choosing to work remotely or in the office the remaining days of the week.
   

  

**About Team**
 The Core Operations Platform is designed to build, integrate, and support a unified technology ecosystem that enables efficient, scalable, and controlled execution of Client and Market Operations processes.
   

  

 It serves as the central backbone for operational workflows, consolidating fragmented systems into a single, orchestrated platform that improves data integrity, reduces manual effort, and enhances operational transparency. This aligns with the broader vision of moving from multi\-system, manual processes to a unified, workflow\-driven model
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Director, Software Engineering is responsible for providing technical leadership, project management, process development, training, support, and a technology vision for the Core Operation Platform. This team is responsible for multiple business processes namely Account Onboarding, Activities, Reconciliation and Reporting. The role will work with Data Services and Portfolio Management technology teams across the Direct Indexing business priorities, to design and develop technology solutions, and to improve business processes. This spans across core services to enable onboarding through our partners as well as business facing websites to allow the efficient onboarding and management of Accounts. These services will help streamline the rule\-based portfolio analytics, order generation and straight through processing allow for exception driven portfolio management.
   

  

 The Director will work closely with the Client Relationship Group and Market Operations for designing efficient applications to onboard accounts while minimizing risk. They will also work with the Digital Team developing services to that will be used by our Financial Advisor portal. In this role, the candidate will develop the appropriate software strategy, striking a balance between: (1\) alignment with the growth objectives of the Business; (2\) higher performance and consistently high quality; and (3\) cost effective application structure and use of new technologies.
   

  

 This leader will shape the long term product vision, drive engineering excellence, partner closely with business stakeholders, and ensure scalable, intuitive user experiences across operational teams.
   

  

 This is a senior leadership role accountable for setting direction, executing delivery, and building a high performing team that modernizes how users interact with operations platform and supporting data systems.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
**Strategy \& Vision**
* Define and execute the technology roadmap for the Core Operations Platform, aligning investments and capabilities with business priorities and long\-term growth objectives.
* Drive architecture and technology decisions that promote scalability, resiliency, security, and operational efficiency.
* Contribute to and help advance the AI and automation strategy for the Core Operations Platform, focusing on practical use cases that improve efficiency and decision\-making.


**Product \& Delivery Execution**
* Lead the design, development, and delivery of technology solutions supporting account onboarding, operational workflows, reconciliation, reporting, and client servicing.
* Champion engineering best practices, including software quality, automation, performance optimization, and continuous improvement.


**Business Engagement \& Stakeholder Partnership**
* Partner closely with Operations, Client Relationship Group, Digital, Data Services, and Portfolio Management Technology teams to identify and deliver high\-impact solutions.
* Translate business needs into technology strategies that improve user experience, operational efficiency, and risk management.


**People Leadership \& Organizational Development**
* Build, lead, and develop a high\-performing engineering team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and innovation.
* Recruit, mentor, and retain top talent while supporting career development and succession planning.


**Governance, Risk \& Operational Excellence**
* Ensure technology solutions adhere to regulatory, security, and operational risk standards while maintaining platform stability and reliability.
* Establish strong governance, support, and change management practices that enable effective delivery and continuous operational improvement.


**Job Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science
* Asset management industry experience preferred.
* 15\+ years of hands\-on development experience managing all aspects of technical projects with a proven track record of delivering well architected and well written software solutions.
* 7\+ years of Experience supervising and guiding software development teams and fostering an engaging, collaborative environment.
* 10\+ Years of Experience developing scalable solutions with advanced programming languages including .Net and Java framework.
* Proven track record of becoming a subject matter expert in areas related to current assignments.
* Strong leadership skills including:
+ Vision and strategy
+ Influencing and consensus building
+ Communication
+ Total quality commitment
+ Ownership and accountability
+ Project management

* Successful track record of development and implementation of an innovative strategic vision and plans, and competence in building strategies to deliver technology to meet business goals and objectives. Ability to transform strategy into tactical plans and delivery.
* A creative, self\-confident self\-motivator with a "can do" orientation, along with the ability to function both independently and as a member of a team. Can work well in a fast paced entrepreneurial environment.
* Passionate, forward thinking and creative individual with high ethical standards and integrity.
* Ability to collaborate and partner as a business professional. The ability to facilitate, gain compromise and/or consensus within diverse teams.
* Assertiveness balanced with a sensitivity toward and concern for people. The ability to create strong work ethics and committed teams, foster open dialogue, and promote individual and team success.
* Superior written and verbal communication skills in customer and internal environment.

 BDx Data Centers is an AI\-ready digital infrastructure platform operating across Asia\-Pacific, with data centers in Singapore, Indonesia, Hong Kong, and Taiwan, and new markets in development. We deliver the powered, cooled, and connected capacity customers need to scale AI, cloud, hyperscale, and enterprise workloads across the region.
 



  





 Our platform brings together secured power access, high\-density design, advanced cooling capabilities, interconnection, and local market execution to accelerate delivery from grid connection to live workload. With 1\.2GVA\+ of secured grid capacity and a platform spanning campuses, hyperscale facilities, colocation, and edge infrastructure, BDx is built to support the next generation of digital growth.
 



  





 Backed by I Squared Capital, BDx is transformed for AI and proven at speed.
 



  





 For more information, visit www.bdxworld.com
 



  





  





 Assistant Vice President (Data Center Automation)
 



  





 Role Summary
 



  





 The Assistant Vice President of Data Center Automation is a senior leadership role responsible for driving the automation, optimization, and security of data center operations. This position oversees Building Management System (BMS) operations, and OSS/BSS (Operational Support Systems/Business Support Systems) functions, ensuring seamless integration, efficiency, and resilience across all systems. The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background, strategic vision, and proven experience in managing large\-scale data center and telecom/IT service environments.
 



  





 Technical Scope of Work
 



 System Architecture \& Design
 



 Define and document the overall control architecture, including:
 



 PLC/DDC network hierarchy and supervisory levels.
 



 OT LAN segmentation, VLAN design, and IP plan.
 



 Redundancy and failover logic for automation systems.
 



 Develop IO lists, control philosophy documents and functional design specifications (FDS).
 



 Coordinate between MEP consultants, controls contractors, and operations to align automation design.
 



 Control System Development \- Must
 



 Author control sequence logic for:
 



 Power systems: Need to have good understanding of the capacity framework and working design of UPS, LV/MV switchgear, gensets, fuel systems, PDUs
 



  





 Cooling systems: Need to have good understanding of the capacity framework and working design of chillers, CRAHs, pumps, valves, cooling towers, heat exchangers.
 



 Configure and validate PLCs, DDCs, and SCADA servers (Schneider / Siemens / Rockwell / Honeywell).
 



 Standardize data points and naming conventions across all systems.
 



 Implement interoperability via BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP/IP, OPC\-UA, and MQTT brokers for telemetry aggregation
 



  





 Commissioning \& Validation
 



 Develop FAT/SAT scripts for validation of control logic, redundancy, and failover scenarios.
 



 Execute alarm and trend validation to ensure full functional coverage.
 



 Oversee integration testing with DCIM, AIops, or energy optimization platforms.
 



  





 OT \& Cybersecurity Governance
 



 Define the OT framework for automation systems, including:
 



 Network segregation between IT and OT.
 



 Firewall and DMZ policy enforcement.
 



 Patch management and backup strategy for controllers and servers.
 



 Align systems to IEC 62443 or equivalent cybersecurity compliance framework.
 



 Operations Enablement \- Must
 



 Create O\&M procedures for BMS / SCADA systems including:
 



 Change management and version control.
 



 Alarm rationalization and escalation protocols.
 



 Data historian configuration and retention policies.
 



 Develop automation analytics dashboards to track PUE, thermal KPIs, and predictive maintenance metrics.
 



 Maintain system access logs, firmware inventories, and security posture reports
 



 Continuous Optimization \- Must
 



 Collaborate with design and operations teams to:
 



 Tune PID loops and optimize control setpoints.
 



 Integrate AI models for predictive control.
 



 Support digital twin deployment and data validation
 



  





 Contract and Stakeholder Management
 



 Manage relationships with technology vendors, service providers, and internal stakeholders to ensure seamless operations and project execution.
 



 Negotiate contracts and oversee service\-level agreements (SLAs) to maintain high standards of performance.
 



  





 At BDx, we believe that our success lies in the hands of our talented and dedicated employees. Together, we are shaping the future of the data center industry and making a positive impact on the world.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Distributed Systems
description:
About the Role
 
 We are seeking a senior software engineer with expertise in distributed systems \& event driven architecture to help design and build the core infrastructure of a research\-driven technology platform.
 



  





 This is a senior individual\-contributor role for an engineer with strong foundations in distributed systems, backend architecture, real\-time data processing, and data\-intensive applications. You will work closely with our research and engineering teams to translate complex technical requirements into robust, scalable production systems. The role offers significant ownership over architecture, technology choices, and implementation.
 



  




 Responsibilities
 * Design and build scalable, reliable backend and distributed systems.
* Architect services for real\-time and asynchronous data processing.
* Develop infrastructure for managing large volumes of time\-dependent and continuously evolving data.
* Design efficient data models, storage systems, and retrieval mechanisms.
* Build systems that support versioning, historical reconstruction, lineage, and auditability.
* Develop event\-driven architectures and streaming data pipelines.
* Ensure reliability through fault tolerance, replay, recovery, idempotency, and appropriate consistency guarantees.
* Optimise systems for performance, scalability, maintainability, and operational simplicity.
* Establish engineering standards and contribute to key architectural and infrastructure decisions.
* Take ownership of major systems from initial design through production deployment and operation.



  




 Qualifications \& Experience
 * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with substantial experience in backend, infrastructure, or distributed systems engineering.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, systems design, and production reliability.
* Experience building and operating production\-grade, data\-intensive applications.
* Experience with event\-driven, streaming, stateful, or temporal systems.
* Strong understanding of databases, data modelling, versioning, lineage, and historical data management.
* Experience with technologies such as
 **Kafka, Redpanda, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, object storage, or comparable systems** 
 .
* Proficiency in at least one backend or systems programming language such as
 **Go, Rust, Java, C\+\+, or Python** 
 .
* Experience designing systems for fault tolerance, replay, recovery, idempotency, and consistency.
* Ability to independently design systems, evaluate technical trade\-offs, and drive implementation from architecture through production.
* Experience in financial technology, market data, observability, distributed databases, scientific computing, or other high\-throughput data environments is valuable.



  




 Candidate Profile
 
 You are a strong systems engineer who enjoys solving difficult infrastructure problems where the solution is not already defined.
 



  





 You are comfortable working at both the architectural and implementation level, can reason clearly about trade\-offs between performance, reliability, complexity, and cost, and can build systems that remain robust as they scale.
 



  





 You will be joining a multidisciplinary team working across engineering, mathematics, and computational research, so the ability to collaborate effectively with highly technical researchers is important.

title: SCT-Tech Enablement-Digital supply chain lead-FDE-Manager

 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.

 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

 We are seeking a talented and experienced Supply Chain Lead (FDE) with 9–12 years of experience to join our growing Digital Supply Chain Team. You will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, and cross\-functional teams to deliver innovative digital solutions that drive business value and enhance user experiences.

* Contribute to CI/CD implementation, DevOps practices, and cloud\-native development initiatives.
* Mentor junior developers and support knowledge\-sharing across teams.

* 6–10 years of hands\-on experience in full\-stack application development.

* Experience in back\-end development using one or more technologies such as Node.js, .NET Core, Java Spring Boot, or Python.
* Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and API integration patterns.
* Experience working with relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, etc.).
* Familiarity with version control systems such as Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Experience in development of Responsive UI components for Agentic AI / RAG based applications
* Should be able to Work back with data engineers, data scientists, and UX designers to integrate LLM and agentic frameworks (like LangChain or FastAPI backends)
* Experience with CI/CD tools and DevOps practices.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong understanding of software design principles, data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented programming concepts.
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Exposure to serverless architectures and event\-driven application design.
* Experience working with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar deployment tools.
* Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and test\-driven development practices.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth, OpenID Connect, or SAML.
* Exposure to AI\-enabled development tools and modern engineering productivity practices.
* Ability to mentor junior team members and contribute to technical standards and reusable frameworks.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply** 
 : If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
